name: proposal
description: A change the assistant is asking permission for, with the two answers next to the question. Use it when a change removes something, or when the assistant is guessing.

summary.description: The question in plain words. Say what would change and why it is being asked.

detail.description: One extra line naming exactly what would change, so nobody says yes to a surprise.

accept.description: URL the yes answer posts to.

dismiss.description: URL the no answer posts to.

wcag.notes: A named group holding the question and both answers, so the question is announced with the buttons rather than separately (1.3.1). Nothing is preselected and nothing happens on a timer, so the change is only ever made on purpose (3.2.5). Both answers say what they do.

machine.identify: A group whose accessible name is the question. Read data-proposal for its id.
machine.operate: Activate one of the two buttons. Nothing changes until you do.

props.detail: You signed in with a subscription, so the key setup step is no longer needed.

props.summary: Move the calendar into the side pane?
